title: Adapt preference manifest: adjudicated adaptation candidates
description: Output of `adapt --manifest`, resolved by automated calibrated-primary adjudication, and consumed by `adapt --apply-from-manifest`. Each record is explicit accepted/rejected; payload_sha256 detects content edits; the schema refuses pending statuses on apply.

batch_id.description: Must match the journal's most recent pending batch_id; mismatches refuse apply.

installation_id.description: Stable schema-v2 UUID of the installation that mined this batch.

canonical_pool_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical MemRight Adapt pool used during synthesis.

source_session_ids.description: Session IDs bound to this batch; state advances only over this set after successful writes.

records.description: May be empty when a successfully mined batch yields no durable candidates; apply commits the bound sessions without writing MemRight rows.

rule.description: Mutable on review (admit/reject only); the payload_sha256 detects edits.

category.description: Controlled taxonomy; reject if not in admission.ALLOWED_CATEGORIES.

authority_manifest_sha256.description: Binds this immutable candidate payload to the embedded authority manifest used at admission.

status.description: Adjudication decision. 'pending' is the emit-time default; apply_time_validate (apply-time) refuses pending.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the immutable candidate payload, including record type, authority effect, and authority-manifest binding when present. Detects any content edit.

evidence_excerpt.description: Bounded evidence fragment (not the full prompt); redaction already applied at extract.

retrieval_aliases.description: Bounded, scanner-clean source-language cues embedded for retrieval only.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source session's transcript bytes at emission time.

source_file_hashes.description: Per-session transcript hashes; reviewers can pinpoint which transcript the rule was mined from.

evidence_id.description: Stable ID for a specific evidence excerpt; derived from sha256(scope + NUL + excerpt)[:8].

evidence_ids.description: Stable evidence IDs so reviewers can cross-reference specific excerpts without ambiguity.

operation.description: Synthesis operation that produced this candidate. Excluded from payload_sha256.

machine.description: Optional installation attribution. Excluded from payload_sha256.

machine_only.description: When true, the rule applies only on machine. Excluded from payload_sha256.

lifecycle_state.description: Rule lifecycle axis. Excluded from payload_sha256.

last_verified_at.description: Optional reverification timestamp. Excluded from payload_sha256.

verification_count.description: Optional reverification count. Excluded from payload_sha256.

scope_dimensions.description: Structured narrowing facets. Excluded from payload_sha256.
